transformations.name: VARIABLE_RENAME
transformations.description: Rename local variables using a deterministic seed-controlled pool mapping (e.g. i→idx, result→output). Collision-safe: new names are checked against existing scope names.
transformations.strategy: AST NodeTransformer + _ScopeCollector to find local names, then pool-based rename map
transformations.notes: Skips dunder names and function names. Only renames names present in RENAME_POOL.

transformations.name: FUNCTION_RENAME
transformations.description: Rename helper function definitions and all their call sites. Skips dunder methods and 'main'.
transformations.strategy: AST NodeTransformer updating FunctionDef.name and all Call nodes referencing the function
transformations.notes: Falls back to _fn_ prefix when no suffix substitution rule matches.

transformations.name: DEAD_CODE_INSERT
transformations.description: Insert unreachable code blocks (if False: ..., while False: ...) at random statement-level positions up to depth 2.
transformations.strategy: Recursive statement list augmentation; dead templates chosen from a fixed pool
transformations.notes: Insertion probability per statement = 0.4. Maximum recursion depth = 2.

transformations.name: COMMENT_STRIP
transformations.description: Remove all docstrings and inline # comments. Two-pass: tokenize strips comments, AST strips docstring Expr nodes.
transformations.strategy: tokenize.generate_tokens to remove COMMENT tokens; ast.walk to remove leading string Expr nodes from function/class/module bodies
transformations.notes: If tokenize fails, falls back to AST-only pass. Empty bodies receive a Pass node.

transformations.name: LOOP_REWRITE
transformations.description: Convert for-range loops to while loops; convert list comprehensions to list(genexpr).
transformations.strategy: AST NodeTransformer: For→While with explicit init/increment; ListComp→list(GeneratorExp)
transformations.notes: Mode selected based on what constructs are present in source. Handles positive and negative step. Negative-step range uses Gt comparison.

transformations.name: CONDITION_REWRITE
transformations.description: Rewrite comparisons using De Morgan's law: a > b → not (a <= b); BoolOps: (a and b) → not (not a or not b).
transformations.strategy: AST NodeTransformer visiting Compare and BoolOp nodes; probabilistic application (p=0.6 for Compare, p=0.4 for BoolOp)
transformations.notes: Only rewrites single-op Compare nodes to avoid ambiguity with chained comparisons.

transformations.name: INLINE_FUNCTION
transformations.description: Inline a small helper function (≤5 stmts, single return, no recursion, no *args/**kwargs) at all call sites and remove its definition.
transformations.strategy: Find inlineable top-level functions, substitute formal params with actual args in the return expression, remove the FunctionDef
transformations.notes: Only inlines calls with positional args matching parameter count. Skips keyword-argument calls.

transformations.name: EXTRACT_FUNCTION
transformations.description: Extract a contiguous slice (2–3 stmts) of pure computation from a function body into a new helper function.
transformations.strategy: Identify slice with no control-flow side effects; determine params (used-before) and returns (used-after); generate _extracted_<seed>_<start> helper
transformations.notes: At most 1 return variable per extraction to keep it safe. Inserts helper before the host function in module body.

transformations.name: CONSTANT_FOLD
transformations.description: Pre-compute constant arithmetic/boolean/string binary expressions and constant unary operations. Also folds constant IfExp (ternary).
transformations.strategy: AST NodeTransformer visiting BinOp, UnaryOp, BoolOp, IfExp; guarded against division-by-zero, huge powers, mixed-type string/numeric
transformations.notes: Does not fold x*0 because this is not type-safe (e.g. list*0 vs int*0). Caps result magnitude at 10^15.

transformations.name: FORMAT_NORMALIZE
transformations.description: Normalize whitespace, blank lines, and indentation via AST round-trip (ast.unparse) plus post-processing to compress consecutive blank lines and strip trailing spaces.
transformations.strategy: ast.parse + ast.unparse to get canonical form; then line-level post-process for blank line compression
transformations.notes: Only changes formatting, never logic. Will not transform already-normalized code (validate may return False for clean inputs).

transformations.name: EQUIVALENT_DATA_STRUCTURE
transformations.description: Replace empty list literals/constructors with collections.deque() where only stack/queue operations (append, pop, extend) are used on the variable.
transformations.strategy: Identify empty list assignments; verify only safe method calls are used (no indexing, no slicing, no unsafe function calls); replace with deque(); inject import collections
transformations.notes: Adds `import collections` at top of module. Only replaces variables that pass the safety check.

transformations.name: ALGEBRAIC_REWRITE
transformations.description: Apply algebraic identity rewrites: x*2→x+x, x-0→x, x+0→x, x*1→x, x/1→x, x**1→x, x**0→1, x-x→0, x&x→x, x|x→x.
transformations.strategy: AST NodeTransformer visiting BinOp; probabilistic application (p=0.7) for x*2→x+x to avoid over-application
transformations.notes: x*0 is NOT rewritten (unsafe for non-numeric types). x-x and x&x/x|x only applied to simple Name nodes to avoid duplicate side effects.
